title: Work · Creosote Labs
meta_description: Recent client work and projects from Creosote Labs, including an operations and systems engagement for a river outfitter.

case.client_text: A river outfitter running approximately 60 trips per year. The office ran on Excel, OneDrive, HubSpot, QuickBooks Desktop, and paper.
case.situation: Trip information was maintained in five separate places. Menu planning went out to customers as four attachments with each confirmation. Operating procedures were not documented.
work: Built a customer-facing meal-planning application that trip clients use to plan and submit their menus, replacing the attachments.
Rebuilt the trip tracker with a due date and completion date for every milestone of every trip.
Wrote the staff reference guide and new-hire training guide.
Set up Claude on the office computer with a reference folder built from the company's own documents, including invoice generation from the company's existing templates.
case.ongoing: Creosote Labs continues to support the client's operations on an ongoing basis.
